question: What are the training completion and 6-month employment rates for women by district and year?

view.title: Women's Training Completion and 6-Month Employment by District
view.note: Two rates are shown for each district and year. Training completion rate is the number of women who completed training divided by the number enrolled, expressed as a percentage. Employment rate is the number of women employed at 6 months divided by the number enrolled, expressed as a percentage. Use the year selector to focus on one year or compare both years side by side. Use the indicator selector to view one rate at a time.

interpretation_guard.caveat: This data is a synthetic fixture and does not represent real programme outcomes. No causal claims can be made.
